- (26 June 2023 - 8 July 2023) Audrey asks Andrew to share outdoor photos and details about his hike, expressing her love for nature's calming effects. Andrew describes his peaceful hike and looks forward to more outdoor adventures. Audrey shares memories of a serene hike she took with friends near a lake, and Andrew expresses his appreciation for such peaceful experiences.
- (11 July 2023 - 4 August 2023) Andrew shared his experience volunteering at a pet shelter and his upcoming camping trip. Audrey discussed her agility classes with her dogs and a recent trail hike. Both expressed joy and the calming effects of spending time with animals and in nature.
- (24 August 2023 - 24 September 2023) Andrew told Audrey about his recent fishing trip and asked if she had ever gone fishing. Audrey shared a photo of her dogs at a lake and discussed her experience with self-care and caring for her dogs. Andrew mentioned his work stress and outdoor activities taking a backseat, while Audrey offered support and shared a photo of her dogs playing at a playdate.
- (6 October 2023 - 19 October 2023) Andrew discussed his recent adoption of a new puppy named Buddy and how both he and his existing dog Toby are adjusting. Audrey shared her joy from buying toys for her dogs and how it reminded her of the happiness they bring. Both expressed how pets enhance their lives with joy and companionship.
- (28 October 2023 - 4 November 2023) Audrey and Andrew discussed their plans to hike with their dogs on Saturday, expressing excitement and sharing photos of trails and lakes. They also talked about their experiences with dog owner groups and tips for keeping dogs active and mentally stimulated in the city. Both expressed appreciation for their friendship and support.
